description: This PHP source file defines the class `iFrameDashlet`, which extends the `Dashlet` class. It manages an iframe-based dashboard widget within the SuiteCRM application, enabling configuration of the iframe URL, height, and refresh options, and rendering the iframe in the dashboard.

classes.name: iFrameDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for embedding an iframe with configurable URL, height, and refresh options within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with options, setting default values and handling configuration.

methods.name: checkURL
methods.description: Validates that the URL scheme is either http or https; defaults to about:blank otherwise.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration options interface for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and saves user-provided configuration options.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML output for the iframe dashlet, embedding the configured URL.
